thread:
alex: FYI we're seeing a small but reproducible mismatch between SDK v2.8.0 and runtime v4.0.0 for response truncation tests against model-group 'multiturn-assistant'. Failing only when client uses streaming + stop sequences. Change window request: schedule a temporary SDK pin for that model-group during next rollout (03:30-04:30 UTC) while we validate a fix.

sam: can you paste the failing example?

alex: minimal repro: ```
POST /v1/chat/stream
body: { model: \"multiturn-assistant\", streaming: true, stop: [\"\nUser:\"] }
// expected: server stops before emitting the stop token
// observed: final chunk still includes trailing stop token on v4.0.0 + sdk v2.8.0
```

maya: heads-up: we patched a streaming flush optimization in runtime 4.0.0 to reduce tail latency. That likely changed chunk framing.

qa-eng: we only see failures when SDK frame-flush uses async iterator with small batches (node). Python SDK not hitting it.

alex: propose: route SDK v2.8.0 clients for multiturn-assistant to runtime v3.9.7 until we release SDK v2.8.1 with framing fix. Plan is region-global for the rollout window but not for Dedicated customers.

eng-release: need precise deploybot commands + a short rollback plan. Also add release-note blurb for SDK/Interop. Keep the change window limited and ensure we add a canary group.

alex: deploy commands I tested in staging: ```
/deploybot pin sdk --model-group multiturn-assistant --sdk-version v2.8.0 --runtime v3.9.7 --scope global --exclude-dedicated --until 2026-04-01T04:30:00Z --reason \"streaming framing interop with runtime 4.0.0\"
```

deploy-bot: received pin-request 3300012345. Please confirm with `confirm-pin 3300012345` within 15m.

sam: question: does excluding dedicated skip customers with pinned runtime? we should ensure no silent surprises.

maya: exclude-dedicated will not touch customer-dedicated pools. Their routing is overridden by tenant config. This pin only affects hosted routing for public tenants.

alex: rollback criteria: if any of the canary customers see >=2 streaming truncation reports within 10 minutes after pin, unpin immediately and revert routing: `/deploybot unpin sdk --model-group multiturn-assistant --sdk-version v2.8.0` and open an incident.

eng-release: add to release-notes draft: \"Temporary SDK-targeted routing to maintain streaming-stop behavior for SDK v2.8.0 + multiturn-assistant while SDK v2.8.1 (framing fix) rolls out. Affects hosted customers only; dedicated unaffected. Window: 03:30-04:30 UTC.\" I'll post once we have confirmation.

sdk-ci: pre-release build 2.8.1 pushed: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/sha-abc123. QA job passed for python; node tests still flaky in CI run 78.

alex: i'm going to confirm the pin after we run a quick node-canary of 20 streaming sessions. Starting job: canary-3300012345.

deploy-bot: action confirmed by alex. Pin applied: SDK v2.8.0 -> runtime v3.9.7 for model-group multiturn-assistant. Exclude: dedicated. Started at 3300012370. Expires 2026-04-01T04:30:00Z.

qa-eng: node canary results: 20/20 streams now stop correctly against pinned runtime. tagging logs: https://logs.redwood.example/streams/3300012345/canary

sam: good catch. Please file a follow-up task to validate SDK 2.8.1 on runtime 4.0.1 once runtime patch lands. Also update client SDK changelog with the interop note.

alex: opened ticket RW-5821 for follow-ups and linked CI build.

eng-release: I'll add an internal note: \"If we need to unpin, use `confirm-unpin` to avoid race conditions with auto-expiry.\" Also drafting the public release snippet and will coordinate comms with support.

deploy-bot: reminder: pin 3300012345 will auto-expire at 2026-04-01T04:30:00Z unless extended.

maya: capturing kernel diff for the flush optimization, tagging runtime infra. We should consider a micro-patch to preserve chunk boundaries for streaming clients.

alex: thread done once SDK 2.8.1 verified against 4.0.1 and release notes posted.
